free_parameters.name: vs_only_above
free_parameters.why: integer threshold mapping the input to the boolean config value: vs_only > 0 enables the flag, so the boundary probes at 1 and -1 land on true and false

free_parameters.name: pattern_type
free_parameters.why: per-head pattern type ty chosen different from vertical_and_slash so the taken branch demonstrably overrides ty; the branch condition does not read ty

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: the only head id looked up in best_pattern; the branch condition does not read it

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: the target condition depends only on self.config, not on the batch dimension

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: the branch decision is per-call, independent of the number of attention heads

free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: must be >1 so the q_len==1 dense early return does not bypass the target; the branch condition does not read it

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: small valid attention width; the target condition does not read head_dim

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for the deterministic random q/k/v tensors

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU float dtype supported by torch; the branch condition does not depend on dtype
